messages.text:
The generated verifier now passes once the generator avoids ambiguous frequency tie-limit cases and covers runtime-stable invalid cases.

I’m doing the completion audit next: adding a small adapted original-test runner for the benchmark’s target commands, ensuring the verifier has the required valid/invalid coverage per command, then running syntax, wrapper, original-case, and differential checks together.
